newsitem.title: UK: Major won't stay till next UK election - Archer.
newsitem.headline: Major won't stay till next UK election - Archer.

text.p: Leading Conservative Jeffrey Archer said on Friday outgoing Prime Minister John Major would not fight another British election.

"There are a group of us who do not want him to go quickly. He is the leader of our party, he has been the prime minister, we need some experience on that front bench," he told BBC Television after the landslide Labour victory.
"We should take a little time before we jump in and chose someone to take his place," said the millionaire novelist who is a leading Conservative campaigner and former member of parliament.
"I don't think he would consider staying to the next election. He has never suggested to me or anybody else that is what he wanted to do, but we are pushing him to stay," Archer said.

"He did make it absolutely clear yesterday that if he lost, the whole thing would have to be seriously reconsidered. I don't think it is any great secret that he doesn't want to go on to the election," he said.
"There is no need to rush in. We should take our time," Archer said.
